title: Everslaught Invasion
subtitle: AI & Enemy Systems Engineer
description: A Virtual Reality zombie horde mode for the Quest 2 built with Unity.
timelineDescription: Networked enemy AI and core gameplay systems for a fast-paced VR title.

workTopics.title: Networked Enemy AI Architecture
workTopics.description: Architected a P2P networked enemy system using a Character/Controller pattern, enabling authoritative host logic across up to 4 simultaneous players.
highlights: Photon Fusion P2P state synchronisation across concurrent player sessions
Behaviour tree AI (Behaviour Designer) supporting 8+ distinct enemy archetypes
Scalable spawner system managing 50+ enemies simultaneously with minimal overhead
Hot-swap enemy configurations at runtime without interrupting live sessions

workTopics.title: Quest 2 Performance Optimization
workTopics.description: Profiled and optimised the game to meet Oculus Quest 2's strict 72fps budget through systemic, data-driven improvements.
highlights: Enemy pooling and per-type LOD system reducing draw calls by ~40%
Custom low-complexity VR shaders replacing expensive stock materials
Fixed-timestep AI tick budgeting to prevent frame spikes during combat peaks
Memory budgeting pass — reduced peak allocation by 35% across wave modes

work.summary: Work as the Enemy/AI Engineer and Generalist
content: Created P2P networked enemy architecture using a Character/Controller approach
Implemented scalable AI behaviours and tooling
